rundown: Kuching beat Phnom Penh 3-0 at Taha Ariffin Stadium in Sarawak. Kuching led 1-0 at half-time and never looked back.
Goals: Phnom Penh none; Kuching Safawi Rasid 32', Jerome Mpacko Etame 75', Dylan Wenzel-Halls 90'+1'.

Leading the way — Phnom Penh: Callum Timmins 2 total shots; Chanchav Choun 50 accurate passes; Raul Feher 8 defensive interventions. Kuching: Ajdin Mujagic 2 total shots; Ryan Lambert 37 accurate passes; James Okwuosa 8 defensive interventions.
Where Kuching won it: they outshot them 10-7 and put 4 on target to 1.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): the total closed at 3.5 and they combined for 3, under by 0.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 26, 4:54 AM ET. It had Phnom Penh 33%, the draw 30% and Kuching 37%, projecting Phnom Penh 1.1 – Kuching 1.2 (2.4 total, Kuching by 0.1).

Final: Phnom Penh 0 – Kuching 3. Right winner: it had Kuching at 37%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Phnom Penh came in with a 9% above average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (3-0-1, 1.8 scored and 1 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 15 and 14 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.1, they scored 0 (−1.1 goals, 100% under); projected to allow 1.2, they allowed 3 (+1.8 goals, 147% over).

Kuching came in with a 5% below average attack and a 5% stingier than average defense (1-1-2, 1 scored and 1 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 15 and 14 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.2, they scored 3 (+1.8 goals, 147% over); projected to allow 1.1, they allowed 0 (−1.1 goals, 100% under).

The bigger miss was Kuching's scoring (+1.8 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 3 against 2.4 projected (+0.6), about the 65th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±1.7).

Margin: Kuching by 3 against Kuching by 0.1 projected, about the 96th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±1.7).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
KUC ML (-215) at -215: the algo gave it 62% vs 64% fair (-1.6 pts) — won (+0.5u); beat the close (closing fair chance 80%). Draw (+360) at +360: the algo gave it 21% vs 20% fair (+0.5 pts) — lost (-1u). PPC ML (+475) at +475: the algo gave it 17% vs 16% fair (+0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the close (closing fair chance 20%). KUC -1.5 (+120) at +120: the algo gave it 40% vs 42% fair (-2 pts) — won (+1.2u); same number as the close. PPC +1.5 (-165) at -165: the algo gave it 60% vs 58% fair (+2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 3.5 (+110) at +110: the algo gave it 43% vs 44% fair (-1.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 3.5 (-150) at -150: the algo gave it 57% vs 56% fair (+1.6 pts) — won (+0.7u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body: The sharp side by the algo's read was Kuching, who won and covered.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; inputs were missing (PPC lineup rating or past seasons, KUC lineup rating or past seasons).

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.163 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +2.9 goals. It counts toward Soccer scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1968 graded Soccer games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams 0 goals. Team corrections start after 3 graded games for a team.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 2.9 goals), no bet.
